yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃ'va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, janetā, evaṃ sāriputto, seyyathā'pi jātassa āpādetā, evaṃ moggallāno. sāriputto, bhikkhave, sot'āpattiphale vineti, moggallāno uttam'atthe.
